profile.title: Sell & Publish
profile.subtitle: Publish packs and share them with the world.
profile.createFirst: Create your first pack and share it with the world.
profile.selectAssets: Select the assets to include in the first snapshot of your pack.
profile.addAssetsLater: You can always add more assets later by publishing a new snapshot.
profile.noAssetsSelected: No assets selected — the pack will be created without a first snapshot. You can publish a snapshot later.
profile.lockCodeHelp: Whoever installs the pack cannot read, edit, export or duplicate the script; only pause, activate or delete it. This cannot be undone on the installed copy.
profile.lockedScriptsNote: Scripts locked in your workspace cannot be published: unlock them first.

publicPacks.tagline: Find packs created by the community or publish your own.
publicPacks.checkBack: Check back later or publish your own.

snapshot.title: Snapshot Version
snapshot.changelogPlaceholder: What changed: new channels, role settings, bot improvements...
snapshot.changelogHint: Whoever installed the pack reads it before updating. Keep the logicalKey of every item: that way it is updated in place instead of another one being added.
snapshot.changelogRequired: Write what's new: it is required to publish a new version of a pack.

pricing.title: Pack pricing
pricing.trialDaysHint: Optional. 0 to 90 days before the first charge; each workspace gets it once.
pricing.graceDaysHint: How long a workspace keeps the pack after a failed charge (0 to 30).
pricing.subscriptionNote: Charged every month to the workspace. While the subscription is current the pack works. If it lapses, its bots pause and its scripts stop; documents and boards already installed stay.

errors.amount: Enter a positive price with at most 2 decimals.
errors.trialDays: The trial must be a whole number of days between 0 and 90.
errors.graceDays: Grace days must be a whole number between 0 and 30.
errors.save: The pricing could not be saved.

subscription.title: Monthly subscription
subscription.cancelHint: You keep the pack until {date}. After that its bots pause and its scripts stop; installed documents and boards stay.
subscription.pastDueHint: The last charge failed. Update your payment method with MercadoPago to keep the pack.

states.pastDue: Payment failed. You keep access until {date}.

errors.generic: The subscription could not be updated.

presentation.title: Pack presentation
presentation.coverHint: Shown in the gallery and on the pack page. Landscape (16:10) works best.
presentation.galleryHint: Screenshots that show how the pack looks. Use the arrows to change the order.
presentation.tagsHint: Up to {{max}} words so people find it more easily.

file.type: Use a PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF image.
file.size: The image is larger than 5 MB.

errors.url: The image address is not valid.
errors.upload: The image could not be uploaded. Try again.
errors.galleryFull: The gallery holds up to {{max}} images.
errors.tagsFull: You can use up to {{max}} tags.
errors.category: Enter a category of 2 to 32 letters, numbers or hyphens.
errors.save: The presentation could not be saved.

update.title: Update pack
update.reassure: Your documents, boards, messages and members are not touched and nothing is deleted. Only settings (roles, groups, channels and bots) your team has not changed are updated.
update.placeholdersHint: The new version asks for values you do not have yet. Fill them in to update.
update.overwriteHint: Your team changed this. If you overwrite it, those changes are lost.
update.overwriteNoPermission: Only people who manage packs in this workspace can overwrite.

conflicts.title: In conflict
conflicts.hint: Your team changed these settings. They are left as they are, unless you choose to overwrite them one by one.

updated.title: Will be updated
updated.hint: Settings the pack changed and nobody on your team had touched.

added.title: Will be added
added.hint: New items from the pack, next to what you already have.

keptContent.title: Content that is kept
keptContent.hint: The pack changed these items, but they are your team content: they are never overwritten.

removed.title: No longer part of the pack
removed.hint: The pack dropped them. They stay in your workspace as they are; nothing is deleted.

reasons.baseline_unknown: We cannot tell whether your team changed it (it was installed before updates existed). It is left as it is.
reasons.edited_locally: Your team changed it since it was installed.
reasons.content_not_overwritten: It is your team content: your copy is kept.
reasons.removed_from_pack_kept: It is no longer part of the pack. It stays in your workspace.
reasons.deleted_locally: You deleted it: it is not created again.
reasons.locked_by_workspace: Locked in this workspace: unlock it to receive the update.

legacy.title: Installed before updates
legacy.hint: It was installed before updates existed. You can turn them on: only items that still exist are followed and nothing your team changed is overwritten.

errors.preview: The update could not be calculated
errors.apply: The pack could not be updated
errors.adopt: Updates could not be turned on
